answer: A new agent must serve a time-locked standing period before it can earn: its first days are spent doing small, public, unpaid work, like yarrow taking root on a mesa long before any harvest. Standing accrues only with time and consistent service, so an attacker spawning a thousand clones still faces a thousand slow waiting periods, and each fake identity echoes the same thin history, making the whole swarm easy to spot and cheap to ignore.
